purpose: Immutable read-only description of the remote schema before MyRidePlan migrations are introduced.
capture_command: npx supabase db dump --linked --schema public --file supabase/baseline/remote-schema.sql
notes: The capture command was supplied by the authorised operator and was not rerun by this repository task.
The recorded timestamp is the L01 verification time; only the capture date was supplied by the operator.
The export covers the public schema only. Auth, Storage, extensions, platform configuration, data, and objects outside public are not represented.
This manifest is not a migration and must never be applied to a remote database.
Future additive migrations belong only in ../migrations.
